dedupe_keys.name: ffiec central data repository bulk data call reports and uniform bank performance reports

description: Quarterly financial statements of every US commercial bank. The FFIEC bulk data page offers Call Reports for a single period or four periods (balance sheet, income statement and past due loans) and Uniform Bank Performance Report ratios, ranks and statistics, for all commercial banks, downloadable free as tab-delimited or XBRL files by reporting period; both products were updated on 15 September 2026. The Chicago Fed commercial bank data page says it stopped adding data after 2021Q2, that its files hold Report of Condition and Income data from 1976 to 2021 in SAS XPORT format, and that quarterly bank financial data now come from the FFIEC repository, which holds history back to March 2001. Coverage is United States banks, one filing per bank per quarter. Caveats: the XBRL option has had only limited validation, as the page says, and older years sit on the Chicago Fed page. For simulation it gives bank balance sheets for modelling how losses from disasters in a region spread through lending banks. A related catalogue record is the FDIC BankFind Suite.
